symbols.name: Door Sliding Right Hand Open
symbols.description: Right-hand sliding door shown open: tall rectangular frame, two overlapping vertical glass panels on the left, a short vertical handle on the moving panel, and an open track area on the right.
symbols.minimal_description: An open right-sliding door: a rectangular frame with one panel shifted left, leaving a clear opening on the right. Add only one small handle.

symbols.name: Apartment Balcony
symbols.description: Apartment balcony with a four-baluster lower railing and an upper arched fanlight at left; a small open casement or plant-like diagonal detail overlaps the left side of the opening.
symbols.minimal_description: A small apartment balcony with an arched opening and low railing. Add one open side panel as the only secondary cue.

symbols.name: Building Modern 1
symbols.description: Two adjacent peaked-roof modern buildings: a taller left tower filled with zigzag diagonal braces and a shorter right tower divided into two horizontal floors.
symbols.minimal_description: Two adjacent modern buildings with peaked roofs, one tall and one short. Use one diagonal brace on the tall building as the identifying cue.
